justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: No studies demonstrate patient outcome differences between tDPT and MPT graduates.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 18-24 month post-professional degree program; significant tuition cost.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Credential equivalency degree; no specific caseload benefit beyond existing MPT training.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No billing benefit; credential equivalency has no payer impact; does not unlock new CPT codes or billing categories.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Limited employer differentiation from DPT; minimal demand advantage over clinical doctorate.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patients do not distinguish tDPT from DPT or MPT.
justifications.research.methodologyDepth: Most tDPT programs include EBP and research-methods coursework, but at a lighter level than a research doctorate.
justifications.research.publicationTrack: Some capstone work is publishable but the degree is not designed to produce a publication record.
justifications.research.grantReadiness: Limited grant training; insufficient on its own to lead funded research.
justifications.research.pathwayToIndependence: Acts as a credential bridge, not an independent-researcher pipeline; PhD/DSc is the real path.
justifications.research.interdisciplinaryFit: Coursework exposes clinicians to evidence synthesis across disciplines.
justifications.research.efficiency: Online, part-time format makes it relatively low-cost as a stepping stone.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Adds 'DPT' to your name but doesn't create any cash-pay service line.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Doesn't change payer rates; modest title benefit only.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Now common among older PTs; minimal differentiation.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Doesn't enable a scalable practice model.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumers don't distinguish DPT from MPT.
justifications.business.efficiency: Moderate tuition and 1-2 years of part-time study for limited business return.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Useful entry credential for clinical-track or adjunct faculty roles where a DPT is required, though tenure-track typically needs a PhD/EdD.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Some programs include a capstone but scholarship output is modest.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Closes the credential gap to teach in DPT programs.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: EBP coursework typical but variable across programs.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Frequently required or preferred for clinical faculty positions.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Tuition and time are nontrivial relative to a PhD-track alternative.
